Across the garden, the east pavilion began as a chapel and now contains a two-bedroom residence. Those histories explain how one building could host a crowd while its near twin could accommodate someone for the night. Behind them, the four-bedroom Victorian house has its own connection with the grounds. Its library and study open to the garden, giving the family a quieter route outside.
